command: copilot (interactive TUI, driven under a pty)
note: copilot's gate is `permission.requested`, carrying data.permissionRequest.kind = "shell" for an `rm` — the shape source/copilot.rs already decodes to Waiting { reason: "permission: shell" }. Nested under the session uuid because copilot keys its session on the transcript's PARENT DIR. Home path redacted to /Users/dev. Redacted: the recorder's own MCP server / skill inventory (tool NAMES only, no credentials) to generic placeholders — a public repo and an immutable crates.io tarball are the wrong home for one machine's tooling roster, and no decoder reads those fields. Redacted: the recorder's installed plugin roster — skill and agent names, their descriptions, and the install paths that give the names back — to `example-skill-N` / `example-plugin-N:example-agent` placeholders, collapsed to three entries because the COUNT is this machine's inventory size too. Each CLI's own bundled set is kept, told apart mechanically rather than by a name list: a `:` in a claude-code agent type means plugin-provided, copilot tags `<location>builtin</location>`, codex roots its own at `r2/` or `.codex/skills/.system/`. No decoder reads any of these fields and every conformance golden is byte-identical.
